positive_requirements_not_satisfied: selected physical file SHA256 and face index must match, with source style preserved
CSS700 must have an explicit supported native bold mechanism/parameters bound before shaping/metric use; no Regular-for-Bold acceptance
independent expected advance/ink/paint bounds and source-cluster mapping for U+2610/U+2612, then material-visibility oracles within frozen PR50 gate

scope_limit: Not a proof of universal absence in every native version or future supported engine. No alternate runtime/version was approved. Positive exact binding required by CP1 was not obtained.
smallest_technical_decision: Owner may separately authorize an explicit physical-Bold open-font mapping for these two source requests under versioned contract/license/coverage/scientific-security review; otherwise provide a maintained supported synthetic-bold binding/engine path compatible with fixed gate. Neither is authorized or investigated here.

trace.fact: FontConfiguration uses pango_ft2_font_map_new and pango_fc_font_map_set_config; this is the relevant backend, not a Cairo paint route.
get_font_description passes computed font_weight into pango_font_description_set_weight. A request is not evidence of synthetic bold.

Complete create_hb_font builds from mapped hb_face, sets scale/ptem, conditional synthetic slant and variable coordinates. No bold setup or embolden property consumption is present in this constructor.
Raw extents/advance come from pango_font_get_hb_font via hb_font_get_glyph_extents and hb_font_get_glyph_advance_for_direction.
Face initialization handles antialias/hint/autohint, file/index, transform and size. This examined path does not bind an embolden parameter.
FT2 glyph-info/extents dispatch uses pango_fc_font_get_raw_extents for ordinary glyphs; caching/unknown-glyph handling supplies no missing bold binding.
Separate FT2 bitmap route loads/renders the glyph; it is not the path used by Weasy draw/text. Capability in another painter would not establish matching engine ink.
Additional maintained snapshot constructor still exposes scale/ptem/slant/axes in the examined route, without a synthetic-bold binding. Snapshot is a comparison, not a selected runtime.
Additional maintained snapshot extents path retains the raw-extents dispatch; no new runtime was approved.
hb_face/blob extraction does not transform a static Regular physical face into Bold.
Font retains physical hb_face bytes and weight metadata; weight is not an emboldened outline.
Variable-axis instantiation is not applicable to selected static Symbols2 with no variable axes.
Stream creates the Font wrapper from the Pango font; no separate bold binding is established here.
Draw path obtains glyph IDs, metrics and extents and writes to its stream. This is corroboration only: gate prohibits PDF export and primary blocker already exists on geometry-only path.

why_no_execution_request: Installing/running the current candidate would not supply the missing supported binding without a technical choice. Do not spend a synthetic-gate attempt to discover a known unmet entry prerequisite.
